messages:
maya: Heads-up — seeing Redis replication errors in eu-west during canary, ~15% 502s. I'm pausing today's release. @liam can you take oncall?
deploybot: deploybot notice: Scheduled release #2317 -> PAUSED by automation due to incident: redis_replica_error. To pause manually: `deploybot pause --release 2317 --reason \"redis flapping\"`
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-342 (redis eu-west). Oncall paged: @liam. Incident link: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-342
liam: oncall here. quick look at logs: replication lag spikes after a traffic burst to canary. Canary 502s ~15%. Agree with hold. No evidence of data corruption so far.
sara: thanks @maya. Question: do we rollback to v1.4.8 or pin+wait? my vote = pin + re-evaluate in 1h.
juan: rolling back drops the auth fix. prefer pin unless we see data risk. ops can force rollback if needed.
maya: leaning pin+wait. Can we try a fast nginx tweak on canary to reduce 502s? `increase_proxy_read_timeout` maybe.
liam: good call. I'll roll `nginx:increase_proxy_read_timeout=90s` to canary hosts now. will report metrics in ~10m.
sara: I'll mark the release state in Release Conductor: "on hold - incident INC-2026-342" and update release notes.
deploybot: FYI: deploybot will not auto-rollback. To rollback: `deploybot rollback --release 2317 --to v1.4.8` (manual action)
maya: we're not rolling back yet. plan: pin release 2317 to prevent accidental resume -> `release-manager pin 2317 --reason \"INC-2026-342\"`. @juan can you set a contingency change window for tomorrow 14:00 UTC?
juan: done. Change window created: 2026-03-22 14:00 UTC — notified eng + cs. (tag: contingency)
sara: drafting a short customer-facing status: "Release paused due to transient infra incident affecting canary. No data loss. We're monitoring; ETA for re-eval 1h." will post to status page.
liam: nginx change applied to canary. quick metrics: 502s -> 1.8% now. continuing to monitor.
maya: cool. hold for 30m and re-eval. if <2% we can resume a controlled canary. @deploybot confirm hold.
deploybot: Confirmed: release 2317 status = PAUSED. Next scheduled check: +30m. :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: Incident page updated with mitigation steps and RCA stub.
sara: release note updated and placeholder for postmortem added.
liam: 30m update: 502s stable ~1.2%. I'm comfortable to resume canary at limited traffic. propose canary 15% for 15m then evaluate for full rollout.
maya: go ahead. command: `deploybot resume --release 2317 --canary 15% --stages 15m`
deploybot: Command accepted. Resuming release 2317 with canary 15% for 15m. Monitoring hook -> #slo-alerts. Will notify thread on thresholds.
sara: posting an internal note summarizing timeline and next steps. will follow up with customers after we verify stability.
maya: thanks all. keeping this thread as the single source for the release state. will reopen if anything regresses. :thumbsup:
_meta: generated for dataset: incident-triggered release hold and rescheduling
